content:
The shaded sector lies in the left semicircle. Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the angles in that semicircle sum to \(180^\circ\):

\[
40^\circ+x+30^\circ+45^\circ=180^\circ
\]

where \(x\) is the central angle of the shaded sector. Thus,

\[
x=180^\circ-40^\circ-30^\circ-45^\circ=65^\circ.
\]

Because the point is chosen uniformly from the disk, the probability is proportional to area. For sectors of the same circle, area is proportional to central angle, so

\[
P=\frac{65^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac{13}{72}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{13}{72}}
\]
